e.title: Open Insurance（巴西）：同意制跨公司保险数据共享框架
e.title_en: Open Insurance (Brazil): a consent-based cross-firm insurance data-sharing framework
e.title_hk: Open Insurance（巴西）：同意制跨公司保險數據共享框架
e.summary: 巴西 SUSEP 主导的国家级开放保险框架：经客户事先同意，在保险公司之间标准化共享数据与服务，含治理三层结构、数据/服务分期开放与「理赔通知、养老金可携带」等服务启动
e.summary_en: Brazil’s SUSEP-led national open-insurance framework: with prior customer consent, data and services are shared across insurers on a standardised basis, with three governance levels, phased data/service opening, and service initiation such as claims notice and pension portability
e.summary_hk: 巴西 SUSEP 主導的國家級開放保險框架：經客戶事先同意，在保險公司之間標準化共享數據與服務，含治理三層結構、數據／服務分期開放與「理賠通知、養老金可攜帶」等服務啟動
e.body:
**Open Insurance（开放保险，又称 Sistema de Seguros Aberto）** 是**巴西由 SUSEP（保险监管局）主导的国家级框架**，其定义经 SUSEP 官方页面实测写明：**「a possibilidade de consumidores de produtos e serviços de seguros, previdência complementar aberta e capitalização permitirem o compartilhamento de suas informações entre diferentes sociedades autorizadas/credenciadas pela Susep」**——**保险、开放式补充养老金与资本化产品的消费者，可授权其信息在经 SUSEP 授权/认证的不同公司之间共享**；覆盖范围因此**不止保险，还包括养老金与资本化产品**。本条目补的是**「国家级、同意制的跨公司数据共享机制」这一形态**：实测池内 **open finance / open banking / open insurance 相关条目为 0**（池内最接近的是 [[openidl]]，但那是**Linux 基金会的保险数据「语言/标准」**，**不是数据共享机制**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **页面 385.5KB（394,802 字节），标题实测「Open Insurance」**；**同意要求**实测写明 **「O compartilhamento … depende de prévio consentimento por parte dos respectivos clientes」**，且同意须为 **「manifestação livre, informada, prévia e inequívoca de vontade, feita por meio eletrônico」**（**自由、知情、事先且明确的意思表示，通过电子方式作出**），用于**特定目的**；实测并明确注明 **「A fase 1 do Open Insurance não envolve o compartilhamento de dados pessoais dos clientes」**（**第一阶段不涉及客户个人数据共享**）。**治理结构**实测写明须建立**至少三个层级**：**Estratégico（战略层，由 Conselho Deliberativo 审议委员会组成）**、**Administrativo（行政层，由 Secretariado 秘书处组成）**、**Técnico（技术层，由 Grupos Técnicos 技术组组成）**，并写明**初期治理结构应于 03/09/2021 前建立、最终形态于 29/11/2024 前建立**。**分期开放内容**实测分为 **Open Data（含 Canais de atendimento 服务渠道、Produtos disponíveis 可用产品）**、**Compartilhamento de Dados Pessoais（含 Cadastro de clientes e participantes 客户与参与者登记、Movimentações 交易、Registros de dispositivos eletrônicos 电子设备记录）** 与 **Efetivação de Serviços（含 Acesso 访问、Modificações 修改、Resgate ou portabilidade 赎回或可携带、Aviso de sinistro 理赔通知）**。**可衍生方案**实测包括 **Comparadores e marketplaces（比较器与市场平台）**、**以数字方式启动保险与养老金服务**，以及**跨机构「财务生活」信息聚合**。**相关入口**实测另有 **SUSEP「Central de Painéis」361.7KB**（监管仪表盘集合）与 **SUSEP「Dados abertos」**（含 PDA 2025-2026 数据开放计划）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「数据共享机制层」这一形态**——池内此前**有开放数据（监管者公布数据）、有隐私/合规条目、有数据标准**，但**「客户授权后在机构之间流转」这一层没有**；Open Insurance 是**监管主导、全行业强制参与**的版本，与 [[openidl]] 的**行业自愿标准路线**形成**两条路线对照**（**一条自上而下靠监管、一条自下而上靠标准**）。**② 它的分期设计对做保险数字化的学生是现成的路线图**——**先开放「渠道与产品」这类非个人数据，再开放「客户登记与交易」个人数据，最后才是「服务启动（理赔通知、养老金可携带）」**；这与 [[susep-sro]] 的「Consulta de Seguros（消费者可查自己名下的保单）」构成**同一条演进的相邻两级**（**SRO 让客户看到自己的保单，Open Insurance 让客户把它授权给别人**）。**③ 「养老金可携带（portabilidade de previdência）」与「理赔通知」被列为可数字化的服务**——**对做香港强积金/退休产品比较的学生，这是一个可对照的制度设计样本**（可与 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[pbgc]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 并读）。**④ 治理三层结构本身是监管科技的组织样本**（战略/行政/技术分工），可与 [[iais-icp]]、[[bis-fsi]]、[[a2ii]] 的监管能力建设口径并读。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、定义、同意要求、治理三层结构、时间节点、分期开放内容与可衍生方案**（**均为页面正文逐字实测**），**但未打开任何 SUSEP 规范性文件（Circular/Resolução）、未核实任何 API 规范或技术手册**，因此**不能转述接口定义、参与机构名单或实际运行状态**；**② 该页面实测未显示「Publicado/Modificado」日期**（与其他 SUSEP 内容页不同），故**本词条不标注该页面的更新日期**；**③ 「开放保险是否已实际落地、覆盖多少机构」本次未核实**——**页面为制度说明性内容，本词条不主张其已全面运行**；**④ 本次未核实与巴西 Open Finance（银行侧）的实际衔接关系**；**⑤ 页面以葡萄牙语为主**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张**该框架提供数据下载或精算工具。**核实说明**：Open Insurance 页（385.5KB）HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取定义、同意、治理与分期内容；Central de Painéis（361.7KB）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开规范性文件或 API 规范、未核实参与机构与实际落地情况**。
e.body_en:
**Open Insurance** (also *Sistema de Seguros Aberto*) is **Brazil’s national framework led by SUSEP**, the insurance supervisor. Its definition, read verbatim from the SUSEP page, is **"a possibilidade de consumidores de produtos e serviços de seguros, previdência complementar aberta e capitalização permitirem o compartilhamento de suas informações entre diferentes sociedades autorizadas/credenciadas pela Susep"** — **consumers of insurance, open supplementary pension and capitalisation products may authorise their information to be shared among different firms authorised or accredited by SUSEP**; the scope therefore covers **not only insurance but also pension and capitalisation products**. This entry adds the **"national, consent-based cross-firm data-sharing mechanism"** form: a measured search found **zero entries for open finance, open banking or open insurance** (the closest item, [[openidl]], is **the Linux Foundation’s insurance data language/standard**, **not a data-sharing mechanism**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **page is 385.5KB (394,802 bytes) with the measured title "Open Insurance"**; the **consent requirement** states verbatim that **"O compartilhamento … depende de prévio consentimento por parte dos respectivos clientes"**, the consent to be a **"manifestação livre, informada, prévia e inequívoca de vontade, feita por meio eletrônico"** (**a free, informed, prior and unequivocal expression of intent made electronically**) for **determined purposes**; it states explicitly that **"A fase 1 do Open Insurance não envolve o compartilhamento de dados pessoais dos clientes"** (**phase 1 does not involve sharing customers’ personal data**). The **governance structure** is stated to require **at least three levels**: **Estratégico (strategic, a Conselho Deliberativo)**; **Administrativo (administrative, a Secretariado)**; and **Técnico (technical, Grupos Técnicos)** — with initial governance to be in place by **03/09/2021** and the definitive form by **29/11/2024**. The **phased opening** covers **Open Data** (**Canais de atendimento** service channels, **Produtos disponíveis** available products); **Compartilhamento de Dados Pessoais** (**Cadastro de clientes e participantes**, **Movimentações**, **Registros de dispositivos eletrônicos**); and **Efetivação de Serviços** (**Acesso**, **Modificações**, **Resgate ou portabilidade**, **Aviso de sinistro**). **Derived solutions** include **Comparadores e marketplaces**, **digital initiation of insurance and pension services**, and **aggregation of financial-life information across institutions**. **Related entry points** measured: SUSEP **"Central de Painéis" (361.7KB)**, its dashboard hub, and SUSEP **"Dados abertos"** (including the PDA 2025-2026 open-data plan).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "data-sharing mechanism layer"** — the corpus previously had **open data (regulators publishing data), privacy/compliance items and data standards**, but **"data moving between firms at the customer’s authorisation" had no entry**; Open Insurance is the **regulator-led, industry-mandatory** version, contrasting with **[[openidl]]’s voluntary industry-standard route** (**one top-down through regulation, one bottom-up through standards**). **② Its phased design is a ready roadmap for insurance-digitalisation work** — **first non-personal data such as channels and products, then personal data such as customer registration and transactions, and only then service initiation (claims notice, pension portability)**; together with **[[susep-sro]]**’s "Consulta de Seguros" (consumers viewing policies in their own name) it forms **two adjacent stages of the same evolution** (**SRO lets customers see their policies; Open Insurance lets them authorise sharing them**). **③ "Portabilidade de previdência" and "aviso de sinistro" are listed as digit-isable services** — **for students comparing Hong Kong MPF and retirement products, this is a comparable institutional design sample** (readable with [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[pbgc]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] and [[pensions-authority-ie]]). **④ The three-level governance structure is an organisational sample of regtech** (strategic/administrative/technical division of labour), readable with the supervisory-capacity work of [[iais-icp]], [[bis-fsi]] and [[a2ii]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, title, definition, consent requirement, three governance levels, the milestone dates, phased contents and derived solutions** (**all read verbatim from the page body**), **but opened no SUSEP normative instrument (Circular or Resolução) and verified no API specification or technical manual**, so **interface definitions, the list of participating firms and the actual operating state cannot be restated**; **② this page measurably shows no "Publicado/Modificado" date** (unlike other SUSEP content pages), **so this entry states no update date for it**; **③ whether open insurance has actually launched and how many firms it covers was not verified** — **the page is institutional description, and this entry does not claim it is fully operating**; **④ the practical link to Brazil’s bank-side Open Finance was not verified**; **⑤ the page is mainly in Portuguese**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim the framework offers data downloads or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the Open Insurance page (385.5KB) was measured at HTTP 200 with the definition, consent, governance and phasing read verbatim; Central de Painéis (361.7KB) was measured at HTTP 200; **no normative instrument or API specification was opened and participating firms and actual deployment were not verified**.
e.body_hk:
**Open Insurance（開放保險）** 是**巴西由 SUSEP（保險監管局）主導的國家級框架**，其定義經 SUSEP 官方頁面實測寫明：**「a possibilidade de consumidores de produtos e serviços de seguros, previdência complementar aberta e capitalização permitirem o compartilhamento de suas informações entre diferentes sociedades autorizadas/credenciadas pela Susep」**——**保險、開放式補充養老金與資本化產品的消費者，可授權其資訊在經 SUSEP 授權／認證的不同公司之間共享**；覆蓋範圍**不止保險，還包括養老金與資本化產品**。本條目補的是**「國家級、同意制的跨公司數據共享機制」這一形態**：實測池內 **open finance / open banking / open insurance 相關條目為 0**（池內最接近的是 [[openidl]]，但那是**保險數據「語言／標準」**，**不是數據共享機制**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **頁面 385.5KB，標題實測「Open Insurance」**；**同意要求**寫明 **「depende de prévio consentimento por parte dos respectivos clientes」**，且同意須為 **「livre, informada, prévia e inequívoca de vontade, feita por meio eletrônico」**；並明確註明 **「A fase 1 do Open Insurance não envolve o compartilhamento de dados pessoais dos clientes」**（**第一階段不涉及個人數據共享**）。**治理結構**須建立**至少三層**：**Estratégico（戰略層，Conselho Deliberativo）**、**Administrativo（行政層，Secretariado）**、**Técnico（技術層，Grupos Técnicos）**，並寫明**初期結構應於 03/09/2021 前建立、最終形態於 29/11/2024 前建立**。**分期開放**分為 **Open Data（Canais de atendimento、Produtos disponíveis）**、**Compartilhamento de Dados Pessoais（Cadastro de clientes e participantes、Movimentações、Registros de dispositivos eletrônicos）** 與 **Efetivação de Serviços（Acesso、Modificações、Resgate ou portabilidade、Aviso de sinistro）**。**可衍生方案**含 **Comparadores e marketplaces**、**以數字方式啟動保險與養老金服務**、**跨機構財務生活資訊聚合**。**相關入口**另有 **SUSEP「Central de Painéis」361.7KB** 與 **SUSEP「Dados abertos」**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「數據共享機制層」**——池內此前**有開放數據、有隱私／合規、有數據標準**，但**「客戶授權後在機構之間流轉」這一層沒有**；與 [[openidl]] 的**行業自願標準路線**形成**兩條路線對照**（**一條自上而下靠監管、一條自下而上靠標準**）。**② 分期設計是現成的路線圖**——**先開放「渠道與產品」非個人數據，再開放「客戶登記與交易」個人數據，最後才是「服務啟動（理賠通知、養老金可攜帶）」**；與 [[susep-sro]] 的「Consulta de Seguros」構成**同一演進的相鄰兩級**。**③ 「養老金可攜帶」與「理賠通知」被列為可數字化服務**——**對做強積金／退休產品比較的學生是可對照的制度設計樣本**（可與 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[pbgc]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]] 並讀）。**④ 治理三層結構本身是監管科技的組織樣本**，可與 [[iais-icp]]、[[bis-fsi]]、[[a2ii]] 並讀。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、定義、同意要求、治理三層結構、時間節點、分期內容與可衍生方案**（**均逐字實測**），**但未打開任何 SUSEP 規範性文件、未核實任何 API 規範或技術手冊**，故**不能轉述接口定義、參與機構名單或實際運行狀態**；**② 該頁實測未顯示「Publicado/Modificado」日期**，故**不標註其更新日期**；**③ 「是否已實際落地、覆蓋多少機構」未核實**——**頁面為制度說明性內容，本詞條不主張其已全面運行**；**④ 與巴西銀行側 Open Finance 的實際銜接未核實**；**⑤ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張**該框架提供數據下載或精算工具**。**核實說明**：Open Insurance 頁（385.5KB）HTTP 200 實測；Central de Painéis（361.7KB）HTTP 200 實測；**未打開規範性文件或 API 規範**。
